description: Unit tests for the TlsChloExtractor class in the QUIC protocol implementation, testing TLS Client Hello extraction, session resumption, multi-packet handling, and move semantics.

classes.name: TlsChloExtractorTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing TLS Client Hello extraction in QUIC.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes test packets with a first flight of packets for the specified QUIC version.

methods.name: Initialize (overload)
methods.description: Initializes test packets with a first flight of packets using a provided crypto configuration.

methods.name: PerformFullHandshake
methods.description: Performs a full handshake to insert an SSL_SESSION into the crypto config for TLS resumption testing.

methods.name: IngestPackets
methods.description: Feeds captured packets into the TLS extractor for processing.

methods.name: ValidateChloDetails
methods.description: Validates the extracted Client Hello details, including ALPN, server name, and client hello bytes.

methods.name: IncreaseSizeOfChlo
methods.description: Modifies the configuration to increase the size of the Client Hello message for testing multi-packet scenarios.
